name: Painting: The Watcher
text: A painting of a single, unblinking eye.
A small brass plate is fixed beneath the frame. (Press F to look closer.)
inspect: The brass plate is engraved:  THE WATCHER - 6

name: Painting: The Key
text: A painting of an ornate iron key resting on velvet.
A small brass plate is fixed beneath the frame. (Press F to look closer.)
inspect: The brass plate is engraved:  THE KEY - 4

name: Painting: The Lantern
text: A painting of an old oil lantern. Its flame looks almost real.
A small brass plate is fixed beneath the frame. (Press F to look closer.)
inspect: The brass plate is engraved:  THE LANTERN - 2

name: Viewing Bench
text: A worn velvet viewing bench. Someone sat here a long time ago.

name: Empty Pedestal
text: A card reads: 'EXHIBIT REMOVED FOR RESTORATION.'
Something is taped under the edge of the pedestal...

name: Curator's Desk
text: You slide open the desk drawer...
inspect: Three equations, scribbled in a hurry.
clue: Curator's note: Display Case code uses X = 14 - 9, Y = 3 x 3, Z = 8 + 4. The archive knows the order.

name: Wiring Panel
title: Fix Wiring
text: The panel cover hangs open. Four wires are loose.

name: Card Reader
title: Swipe Card
text: A card reader blinks red beside the RESTRICTED door.
locked_text: It needs a staff keycard. Search the gallery.

name: Display Case
title: Unlock Display Case
text: A glass display case with a 4-digit keypad.
inspect: Four digits. The curator must have left the code somewhere.
hint: Use the curator's note. Your partner knows the order.

name: Gallery Terminal
title: Upload Data
text: A dusty computer terminal: UPLOAD RECORDS TO EXIT CONTROL.
locked_text: NO DATA TO UPLOAD. Your partner must download the records in the Archive first.

name: Exit Door
text: The exit door is sealed. A panel says: COMPLETE ALL TASKS.
inspect: The exit unlocks when the team finishes every task in both rooms.
